save_results: save optimization results, confidence intervals, and identified model XML files to a specified experiment results folder
save_initial_params: save initial (pre-optimization) parameters to a YAML file in the experiment results directory
save_optimized_params: save optimized (post-optimization) parameters to a YAML file in the experiment results directory
save_optimization_results: save scipy OptimizeResult to a pickle file for later retrieval and analysis
save_confidence_intervals: compute and save covariance and confidence intervals from residuals and Jacobian to a pickle file
save_identified_models: dump identified MuJoCo model specifications as XML files to the experiment results folder
